description:
## Parent

turnkey-vnm

## What to build

Store location (`TURNKEY_CACHE_DIR`), store size (default 5 GiB, LRU) and port can be overridden per user through env or user-level config, never through the repo (spec §6).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Each of the three settings can be overridden without touching the repo
- [ ] The default size is 5 GiB
- [ ] A port override is honoured by the server, the probe and the generated client address alike

## Blocked by

- turnkey-vnm.7
title: Per-user overrides for the test result cache
